input: Use school, college and university summer programs for kids and teens in the Asheville area (public and private schools, UNC Asheville, Warren Wilson, Mars Hill, Brevard College, Western Carolina, A-B Tech) to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.
searches: school summer camp 2026 Asheville Hanger Hall Emmanuel
Appalachian Institute Creative Learning official summer 2026

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: Teen residential pre-college programs, SkillSet maker camps, and youth athletics camps; 2027 pre-college interest form available.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College
candidates.note: College athletics camps include full-day and half-day youth basketball sessions offered in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: Youth sports camps and supervised summer music camp; 2026 music camp ran June 14–19.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures academic enrichment and college sports camps; 2026 basketball camps served ages 6–14.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Youth academic, recreation and athletics camps; 2026 Rocket to Creativity served ages 7–14.

candidates.name: Asheville-Buncombe Technical Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Allied Health summer camp introduced students to healthcare careers through interactive labs.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy offered hands-on enrichment camps for elementary, middle and high school students.

candidates.name: Carolina Day School
candidates.note: August 2026 enrichment camps for rising junior kindergarten–grade 6; restricted to enrolled CDS students.

candidates.name: Horizons at Carolina Day School
candidates.note: Tuition-free six-week summer academy combines reading, math, swimming and arts for eligible local students.

candidates.name: Rainbow Community School
candidates.note: Seven weeks of summer camps for rising grades 1–8; 2026 programs concluded and 2027 listings expected in February.

candidates.name: Odyssey Community School
candidates.note: 2026 day camps included swimming, outdoor play, fiber arts, filmmaking, jewelry, music and game design.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camps offered sports, skill-building and academic enrichment.

candidates.name: Christ School
candidates.note: Sports day and overnight camps; Plumlee Basketball Camp announced for boys ages 10–17, June 21–24, 2027.

candidates.name: Emmanuel Lutheran School
candidates.note: Summer Rocks offers themed summer camps, field trips and Vacation Bible School for elementary-age children.

candidates.name: Buncombe County Schools
candidates.note: Free 2026 agriculture day camp for rising BCS grades 5–8; district also provides summer reading interventions.

candidates.name: A.C. Reynolds High School
candidates.note: School athletics department published youth summer camp information for both 2025 and 2026.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Residential summer music training includes high-school musicians ages 14 and older.

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong full-day and half-day music camps for ages 4–18 and varied skill levels.

candidates.name: PGC Basketball
candidates.note: 2026 residential Scoring College at Mars Hill University for incoming grades 9–12 and older players.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: 2026 Nike boys basketball camp at Warren Wilson for ages 8–16; also lists 2027 overnight running camps in Asheville.

candidates.name: Zaniac Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 STEM summer camps at UNC Asheville and Biltmore Park; offerings included math enrichment.

candidates.name: North Carolina Association of Student Councils
candidates.note: 2026 summer student leadership workshop held at Mars Hill University.

candidates.name: Buncombe County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun day camps covered cooking, agriculture, world cultures and art.

candidates.name: Flat Rock Playhouse
candidates.note: 2026 summer acting and musical theatre camps for rising kindergarten–grade 12.
